metadata.title: Sphere Theorems for $\frac{10}{3}$-Positive Curvature Operator of the Second Kind
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we prove that every connected closed Riemannian manifold of dimension $n\geq4$ with $\frac{10}{3}$-positive curvature operator of the second kind is diffeomorphic to a spherical space form. We also obtain a classification of connected closed Riemannian manifolds with $\frac{10}{3}$-nonnegative curvature operator of the second kind. The key step is to show that $\frac{10}{3}$-positivity implies the PIC1 condition. Finally, we give an example showing that $\frac{10}{3}$ is optimal for deducing PIC1 from $\alpha$-positivity.

analysis.workSummary: 证明 n≥4 的闭连通流形在第二类曲率算子 10/3-正条件下微分同胚于球面空间形式，并讨论非负情形的分类。
analysis.breakthrough: 以 10/3-正推出 PIC1，且举例说明这一步阈值最优。
analysis.limitations: 最优性针对推出 PIC1 的代数阈值，不能自动称为所有拓扑球定理的最优阈值。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
